# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

Load in results from simulations:

```{r load-results}
best_models <- readRDS("Outputs/A/best_models.rds")

C1_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C1/Extinct/initials.rds") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
C2_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C2/Extinct/initials.rds") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
C3_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C3/Extinct/initials.rds") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
C4_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/C4/Extinct/initials.rds") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)

C1_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C1/Extinct/thresholds.rds") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
C2_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C2/Extinct/thresholds.rds") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
C3_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C3/Extinct/thresholds.rds") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
C4_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/C4/Extinct/thresholds.rds") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)

C1_extinct <- left_join(C1_initials, C1_thresholds, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
C2_extinct <- left_join(C2_initials, C2_thresholds, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
C3_extinct <- left_join(C3_initials, C3_thresholds, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
C4_extinct <- left_join(C4_initials, C4_thresholds, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(best_model = model %in% best_models)
```

# Extinct Comparison

Compare C1 with C2, C3, and C4:

```{r extinct-comparison}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 3

C2_joined <- left_join(
  C1_extinct,
  C2_extinct,
  by = c("model", "best_model"),
  suffix = c("_C1", "_C2")
)

C3_joined <- left_join(
  C1_extinct,
  C3_extinct,
  by = c("model", "best_model"),
  suffix = c("_C1", "_C3")
)

C4_joined <- left_join(
  C1_extinct,
  C4_extinct,
  by = c("model", "best_model"),
  suffix = c("_C1", "_C4")
)

max_threshold <- max(
  max(C1_extinct$threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(C2_extinct$threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(C3_extinct$threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(C4_extinct$threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
)

C1_plot <- ggplot(C1_extinct) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power, y = threshold, colour = best_model)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_threshold)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "green", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Power at Extinction",
    y = "Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "C1 (Null)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

C2_plot <- ggplot(C2_joined) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = power_C1, y = threshold_C1, xend = power_C2, yend = threshold_C2),
    colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_C1, y = threshold_C1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_C2, y = threshold_C2, colour = best_model)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_threshold)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "green", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Power at Extinction",
    y = "Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "C2 (Declining Detectability)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


C3_plot <- ggplot(C3_joined) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = power_C1, y = threshold_C1, xend = power_C3, yend = threshold_C3),
    colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_C1, y = threshold_C1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_C3, y = threshold_C3, colour = best_model)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_threshold)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "green", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Power at Extinction",
    y = "Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "C3 (Increasing Survey Effort)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

C4_plot <- ggplot(C4_joined) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = power_C1, y = threshold_C1, xend = power_C4, yend = threshold_C4),
    colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_C1, y = threshold_C1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_C4, y = threshold_C4, colour = best_model)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_threshold)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "green", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Power at Extinction",
    y = "Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "C4 (Combined)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggarrange(C1_plot, C2_plot, C3_plot, C4_plot, ncol = 4)
```
